title: Which Model for Which Role? Cost-Efficient Pareto Recommendation for LLM Agentic Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2610.26676v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM agentic workflows increasingly employ different models for specialized roles. Users may prefer different trade-offs between task quality and deployment cost, sometimes also considering latency. Finding good assignments incurs a separate search cost from evaluating multiple candidates. We introduce Cost-Coupled Gittins (CC-Gittins), a multi-objective extension of single-objective cost-aware Gittins search for Pareto recommendation. It exploits the coupling between evaluation and deployment costs: assignments that cost more to deploy also cost more to evaluate. The search alternates between seeking higher quality and lower deployment cost, reusing each evaluation to inform both searches. After each batch, CC-Gittins recommends assignments that are nondominated under uncertainty-adjusted estimates of quality and deployment cost. We evaluate CC-Gittins on eight quality--cost matrices from workflows with two to five roles and up

translated_title: 哪个模型适合哪个角色？面向LLM智能体工作流的成本高效Pareto推荐
translated_abstract: LLM智能体工作流日益为不同的专业角色采用不同的模型。用户可能在任务质量与部署成本之间偏好不同的权衡，有时还会考虑延迟。寻找良好的模型分配会产生与评估多个候选者不同的额外搜索成本。我们提出了成本耦合Gittins算法（CC-Gittins），这是面向Pareto推荐的单目标成本感知Gittins搜索的多目标扩展。该方法利用了评估成本与部署成本之间的耦合关系：部署成本更高的分配方案，其评估成本也更高。搜索过程在追求更高质量和更低部署成本之间交替进行，复用每次评估来同时为两个搜索方向提供信息。每一批次之后，CC-Gittins会推荐在质量与部署成本的不确定性调整估计下不被支配的分配方案。我们在来自具有两到五个角色的智能体工作流的八个质量-成本矩阵上评估了CC-Gittins
tldr: 提出CC-Gittins算法，通过利用评估成本与部署成本之间的耦合关系，高效地为LLM智能体工作流中的不同角色推荐质量与成本权衡下的Pareto最优模型分配方案
en_tdlr: Proposes CC-Gittins, a multi-objective extension of cost-aware Gittins search that exploits the coupling between evaluation and deployment costs to efficiently recommend Pareto-optimal model assignments for different roles in LLM agentic workflows
